tooling.message:
fix(site): eval runs as tabs with their panel, compare inside the run, actions grouped by status

## Intent

The eval runs on the Prompt engineering page did not show clearly what belongs to the chosen run, what the comparison includes, or what the status of findings and actions means.

## Key changes

- The runs are a row of tabs. The chosen tab joins a framed panel, and everything that belongs to the run sits inside that frame.
- The comparison sits inside each run, above its heatmap. It names the run it compares with, explains ▲ and ▼, and compares with the run before by default.
- Each finding has a line on what it is. Only the actions have a status; they are grouped as Open, Done and Dropped, with a count each, and name the finding they come from.
- Without JavaScript, all runs still appear one after another.
